row:
The goal of this channel is to supply information wrapped in humor in the subject of small animal health. The videos are written, edited and narrated by a veterinarian who has at least a vague understanding of what he's talking about. The coverage of each topic is fact checked by a veterinary expert of the given field.
Stunning special effects... are not the main trait of this channel but their abscence will hopefully not lessen the value of the material too much.
Please keep in mind that the site intends to educate and not provide veterinary consultation on specific cases. You may, of course, ask questions relevant to the topic but diagnosing and curing your pet is the job of your veterinary practitioner! No amount of internet chat can replace a thorough examination and proper treatment based on its results!
I hope you'll find the videos entertaining and useful!

P.S.: Sorry for the occasional hunglish.
